answer: At dawn, each new identity computes one sequential hour of delay to claim nectar. Its proof: a fourteen-verse sonnet, each hashing the last, in order, not parallel, binding its key to that dawn's beacon; anyone re-hashes it in milliseconds. One identity: 38 credits, a 60-credit bond, refunded on proof; 1,000 fakes: 38,000 spent, 60,000 locked. Rented cores pay the same per hour; precomputed proofs fail the beacon; an honest agent pays 38 once.
